messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to enable aurora-13b (v2.1 quant) in catalog tomorrow during the 09:00–11:00 PDT change window. Goal: staged switchover with fallback ordering to legacy-13b.

maria: what's the fallback order? aurora quant -> aurora fp16 -> legacy-13b?

alex: yes. fallback ladder: aurora:v2.1-quant -> aurora:v2.1-fp16 -> legacy:13b-stable. Will pin traffic to v2.1 for 24h after success.

sam: adding rollback thresholds: error-rate > 2% for 10m or p95 latency increase > 50ms over baseline => immediate rollback. also want canary at 5% for 30m.

jing: quant variant shows +30ms p95 in eu in perf tests last night. for EU do regional stagger: us -> eu -> ap.

olivia: can we disable auto-quant fallback? want explicit manual fallback for first rollout.

alex: agree — set fallback policy to manual for the first 24h. I'll annotate rollout notes.

deploy-bot: /deploy schedule canary aurora:v2.1 --start=2026-03-21T09:00:00-07:00 --regions=us,eu --weight=5%

alex: runbook snippet:
```
observe p95 tokens/sec, errors
if errors > 2% for 10m -> /deploy rollback aurora:v2.1
if p95 > baseline+50ms for 30m -> pause traffic and escalate
```

maria: I'll pin model in catalog with `pin=aurora:v2.1@24h` after canary pass. Also adding note in release notes: known EU p95 delta.

ops-bot: Incident channel linked: #incidents will get alerts if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: canary started for aurora:v2.1 in us at 2026-03-21T09:00:00-07:00

sam: started smoke checks. logging looks clean so far. no errors in first 5m.

jing: EU test queue shows 1.2x token latency on quant. monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/aurora/171

olivia: pls keep manual fallback ready. I'll standby for rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to eu region at 2026-03-21T09:30:00-07:00 with weight=5%

deploy-bot: canary complete: passed 30m stability checks. moving to staged ramp.

alex: ramp plan: 5% -> 15% -> 35% -> 60% over 3 hours, monitor between steps. cancel on thresholds.

maria: pinned and updated release notes: "aurora:v2.1 (quant) enabled. fallback manual for 24h. Rollback criteria: errors>2%/p95+50ms"

sam: confirming alerts wired. ops on-call: @olivia

olivia: ack. standby until 12:30 PDT.

alex: thanks all — will open post-rollout checklist thread after 24h.
